title: Acordamos ochenta
desc: The price doubles at the end of the journey
setting: You are standing at the open door of the taxi and the number he has just said is not the number you agreed.

steps.speaker: Taxista
steps.en: That is a hundred and twenty, boss.

options.feedback: Four words, no heat, no explanation. This is the sentence and you are going to say it again in a moment.

options.es: Pero usted me dijo ochenta antes de subir.
options.en: But you told me eighty before I got in.
options.feedback: True, and longer than it needs to be. Every extra word is a door he can push on.

options.en: What do you mean a hundred and twenty?
options.feedback: You asked him a question, so now he gets to answer it. Do not hand him the floor.

steps.speaker: Taxista
steps.es: Es que había mucho tráfico, hombre.
steps.en: The thing is there was a lot of traffic, man.

options.feedback: The same sentence, in the same tone. Repeating it is what wins this, and arguing about the traffic is what loses it.

options.es: El tráfico no era mi culpa.
options.en: The traffic was not my fault.
options.feedback: Reasonable, and you have started discussing the traffic. That is the conversation he wanted.

options.es: Todos los taxistas hacen lo mismo.
options.en: All taxi drivers do the same thing.
options.feedback: Now it is personal and he has something to defend. This was about eighty córdobas thirty seconds ago.

steps.speaker: Taxista
steps.en: Give me a hundred and we are square.

options.en: Eighty, as we agreed. Here you are.
options.feedback: Hold the number and put the money in his hand at the same time. The transaction ends while he is still deciding.
You paid twenty for the lesson. He will try it on the next foreigner because it half works.

options.es: No le voy a dar nada.
options.en: I am not giving you anything.
options.feedback: You owe him eighty and you agreed to it. Refusing the whole fare turns you into the one in the wrong.

options.es: Gracias, hombre. Que le vaya bien.
options.feedback: You won and you closed it warmly, which costs nothing. Nobody here needs the other person to feel beaten.
Fine. A second half to that sentence would have taken the edge off the whole exchange.

options.es: Así debió ser desde el principio.
options.en: That is how it should have been from the start.
options.feedback: You had already won. Saying so out loud is the only thing left that can go wrong.
